posts.title: Evergreen
posts.description: These are notes that are always relevant and constantly being updated and grown throughout the year.

posts.title: Fruit
posts.description: Of course, a knowledge index isn’t much use if it doesn’t inform future thinking and output. Fruits are what I like to call derivative or ’new’ pieces of content. This is new work created from saplings, mostly longer form essays, projects, etc. At this stage, thoughts and ideas have matured enough to be able to share and collaborate.

posts.title: Pattern
posts.description: A pattern in my own pattern language. These represent atomic concepts and observations that appear and reappear within my thinking and work. See the note on 'A Pattern Language' for more information
